name: PT Pool Advista Finance Tbk
summary: PT Pool Advista Finance Tbk operates as a financing company in Indonesia. The company offers working capital, multipurpose, investment financing, sharia, and other financing. The company was formerly known as PT Indojasa Pratama Finance and changed its name to PT Pool Advista Finance Tbk in November 2017. PT Pool Advista Finance Tbk was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia. PT Pool Advista Finance Tbk operates as a subsidiary of PT Pool Advista Indonesia Tbk.
